title: The diagonal hierarchy yields a closed local high-regularity continuation bound

local_continuation.gauge_and_model: Smooth K-finite solutions of the K1359/K1366 charge-regularized cubic scalar-electrodynamics control in Lorenz gauge on R x T3; the gauge-fixed Sobolev norm is analytic control, not a physical quotient pairing
local_continuation.control_norm: Y_R^2 is the componentwise Lorenz-gauge H^(R+1)xH^R wave norm of A plus the K1387 triangular matter energy, for integer R>=3
local_continuation.tame_inequality: dY_R/dt<=C_R B_R Y_R and Sobolev/tame control on T3 gives B_R<=C_R(1+Y_R)^2
local_continuation.local_bound: If Y_R(0)=Y_0, then Y_R(t)<=2Y_0 for 0<=t<=log(2)/(C_R(1+2Y_0)^2) by a bootstrap Gronwall argument
local_continuation.continuation_criterion: The high-regularity control continues across every finite interval on which integral B_R dt is finite
local_continuation.global_boundary: Base energy and Gauss do not control integral B_R dt by K1379, so the hierarchy removes the algebraic top corner but does not prove global large-data propagation
